choices.reason: No rule uniquely separates the candidates: all are parallel creative-task contrasts from the same primary full-sample model and the same post-discussion repeat task, with no uniquely primary contrast or participant-level SD/data_stats advantage. Every AI configuration uses imposed, undisclosed personas; the paper provides neither a uniquely supported free-chatbot or baseline-factor arm nor a combined AI-versus-H3 contrast.
choices.locator: PDF p. 29, Appendix B (quoted passage); pp. 30-31, persona prompts; p. 5, section 3.2; pp. 51-53, Appendix F.1 and Tables 28-29.
choices.quote:
The prompts were designed to operationalise two distinct interaction styles, contrarian and supportive, while
maintaining high ecological validity by enforcing human-like language use, conversational variability, and strict non-
disclosure of artificial identity.
